resources.string: No plugins yet. Import a plugin manifest (.json) to get started.
Tap to switch a plugin on or off. Long-press for details or to delete it.
Import a plugin\'s .json manifest, plus its .dex/.jar file for code plugins. New plugins start switched off.
Code plugins run unsandboxed inside Hanako, with full access to your chats and accounts.
Code plugins can read and send messages, see your account data and send network requests as you. Only allow this for plugins you built or fully trust.
This plugin runs code with Hanako\'s full access to your chats and accounts. Enable it only if you trust its author.
Delete this plugin, its code file and its saved data?
